Mira: Hey team — iter mock for the starter rail is up. Compact left rail that surfaces sample projects + quick actions. Looking for layout vs modal tradeoffs, CTA copy, and a11y nits. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/starter-rail :eyes: Josh: Nice! quick question — is the rail focus-trappable? keyboard users need a clear tab order vs modal. :keyboard: Mira: Not fully prototyped yet. Current idea: rail is tabbable, collapsible, and not a focus trap (so main content still tabbable). open to changing to modal for initial run. Val: If it stays as a non-modal rail we need consistent screen-reader order and clear aria-expanded on each section. Otherwise NVDA users will be lost when it opens. Ana: Copy thoughts — current CTA reads "Create sample project" which is a bit heavy. Options: "Try a sample project" or "Get started with a sample". I prefer "Try a sample project" (short, lower barrier). Mira: Good call. Also thinking of a secondary small link: "Use your own model" for advanced users. Sam (DevEx Bot): NOTE: telemetry/consent banner will need to be surfaced in the onboarding flow for EU customers. Check legal for wording + opt-out rules. Josh: If telemetry lands in the rail it becomes cluttered. Suggest telemetry in a compact modal after first run (one-time). That keeps rail focused on actions. Val: Contrast issue: the CTA in the mock uses #5B6BFF on white — meets heading contrast but smaller button text is failing 4.5:1. Recommend bump to #3348FF or increase weight. Ana: Also, sample project order: should "Chat assistant" be first? Product metrics show new users convert faster with a chat starter. Mira: Analytics FYI — our prototype cohort from last week had 62% choose "Embeddings" when that tile was top. So order matters a lot. Maybe personalize based on quick survey? :thinking_face: Josh: Accessibility detail: when the rail collapses we should remove elements from tab order (use aria-hidden or inert) — otherwise keyboard users tab into invisible things. Quick example I dropped in the design doc: ```html
...
// or use element.inert polyfill ``` Val: Also add visually-hidden explanatory text for the sample tiles: "This template includes prompts, example data, and SDK snippets." SR-only text improves discoverability for screen reader first-timers. Ana: Copy tweak: change sample tile labels from "Embeddings starter" -> "Embeddings: semantically tagged" (too long). Keep label short and use subtitle for detail. Mira: Agree — label short, subtitle for extra. I'll update figma. Josh: One more layout debate — persistent rail vs ephemeral: persistent gives consistent access later but adds cognitive load initially. Ephemeral (show once with a clear "Show again" link) might be less noisy. Thoughts? Val: Ephemeral + control ("Show again" in help) sounds good. Ensure assistive tech users can re-open via main menu. Mira: Action items: Mira -> update Figma with aria labels, short labels + subtitles, and contrast tweak. Josh -> prototype keyboard focus behavior and inert removal. Ana -> finalize CTA copy variants and sample ordering recommendation. Val -> add SR-only descriptions and run contrast checks. I'll talk to PM/legal about telemetry placement. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if aligned and I'll schedule a 30m design crit on Tue. Ana: :thumbsup: Josh: :thumbsup: Val: :thumbsup: Sam (DevEx Bot): Reminder: add the final copy to the content spreadsheet so localization can estimate L10n work. Mira: Thanks all — posting updated figma link after edits.
